sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Nightmare Void.

sections.heading: Description
lines: Haunted Field is a field effect exclusive to Rejuvenation. It is categorized as a Magical field and can be found in Goldenleaf Theater in Goldenleaf Town.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Blessed Field will transform into this field if one of the moves Curse, Ominous Wind, Phantom Force, Shadow Force, Spectral Scream, or Trick-or-Treat is used.
“Evil spirits gathered!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Ghost-type attacks increase in base power by 1.5x and deal neutral damage to Normal-types.
“The evil aura powered up the attack!”
Sleeping non Ghost-type Pokémon take 1/16 max HP damage at the end of each turn.
“[Pokémon]'s dream is corrupted by the evil spirits!”

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Cursed Body always activates upon fainting.
Mimicry changes the user's type to Ghost.
Perish Body additionally traps the opponent when activated.
Power Spot the power of partner's moves by 1.5x.
Rattled additionally boosts the bearer's Speed by 1 stage on switch-in.
Resuscitation resets lowered stat stage changes on activation.
Shadow Tag additionally Frisks the opponent.
Wandering Spirit lowers the bearer's Speed by 1 stage each turn.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Fire Spin, Flame Burst, Flame Charge, Inferno → 1.5x boost, Ghost sub-typing.
“Will-o'-wisps joined the attack...”
Astonish, Bone Club, Bone Rush, Bonemerang → 1.5x boost
“Boo!”
“Spooky scary skeletons!”
Shadow Bone → 1.2x boost
“Spooky scary skeletons!”
Other moves:
Bitter Malice additionally reduces the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Curse, when used by a Ghost type, uses only 25% of the user's HP.
Destiny Bond no longer fails when used consecutively.
Fire Spin deals 1/6 max HP damage each turn.
Fire Spin and Mean Look target both opponents in doubles.
Hypnosis and Will-o-Wisp's accuracy is increased to 90%.
Infernal Parade doubles in power regardless of status.
Lick now has a 100% chance to Paralyze.
Magic Powder additionally inflicts Sleep.
Night Shade now deals damage equal to 1.5x the user's level.
Nightmare deals 33% max HP damage each turn.
Ominous Wind now has a 20% chance to boost all stats.
Phantom Force and Shadow Force only take 1 turn to use.
Scary Face lowers the target's Speed by 4 stages.
Spirit Break now deals super effective damage to Ghost-types.
Spite now depletes 6 PP.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Ghost.
Nature Power becomes Phantom Force.
Secret Power may inflict Curse.
Shelter halves damage from Ghost-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Ghost.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost if it changes the field, unless noted otherwise.
This field will transform into Blessed Field if any of the moves Judgement, Origin Pulse, Purify, or Sacred Fire are used.
“The evil spirits have been exorcised!”
This field will be terminated if either of the moves Dazzling Gleam or Flash are used.
“The evil spirits have been forced back!”
As of v13.5.6, this field interaction only works if Forest Field is below the field.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Magical Seed boosts Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage but Burns the user.
